title: Blueprint task metadata ([_.tasks.<name>] sidecar entry)
description: One entry from a tasks/**/*.meta.toml sidecar. Enforced by tools/validate-blueprint.py, which additionally checks each entry against the task it describes.

icon.description: Icon hint for a UI. Free-form; the consumer maps it to its own icon set.

risk.description: low: read-only or trivially reversible. medium: changes local state, installs software, creates credentials, or contacts external systems. high: destructive, privilege-heavy, or hard to reverse.

enabled.description: false hides the task from catalog consumers without removing it from mise.

category.description: Must equal the task name's prefix before the first colon, or "root" for a task with no colon. Duplicated from the name deliberately so consumers need not parse it; the validator keeps the two in sync.

destructive.description: true when the task can irreversibly destroy state. Implies requires_confirm and risk = "high".

requires_confirm.description: Mirrors the task's native `confirm` property, which mise does NOT expose in any --json output. This is the only machine-readable signal that a task is gated, so a UI must present its own confirmation before passing --yes.

requires_sudo.description: true when the task escalates privileges. Cannot be combined with risk = "low".

interactive.description: Mirrors the task's `raw` or `interactive` property. true means the task hands the TTY to a child process, so a UI must open a terminal rather than capture stdout.

cwd_scope.description: "caller" mirrors dir = "{{cwd}}": the task acts on the invoking directory, so a UI with no meaningful cwd must ask the user for one. "project" means the task runs from the config root.
